entries.wording: Empty Container Release to Shipper
entries.note: The shipper collects an empty container from the depot to load it; the cargo is not yet with CU Lines.

entries.wording: Gate In to Outbound Terminal
entries.note: The loaded container enters the terminal at the port of loading. After the container moved, a further gate in is transit.

entries.wording: Loaded on 'WAN FU DA 2638E' at Port of Loading
entries.note: The wording names the vessel and voyage; the code is the same for every vessel.

entries.wording: Loaded on 'SINGAPORE RIVER 2639W' at Port of Loading
entries.note: The same load with W for the vessel instead of V.

entries.wording: 'WAN FU DA 2638E' Departure from Port of Loading
entries.note: A booking's container list words it as Vessel Departure from Port of Loading.

entries.note: The consignee returns the unloaded container. Before the container moved, it is an empty container returned unused.
